text:
maria: Quick sync — I'm drafting a compact launch playbook + one-pager for the webinar on Thu. Need sharp competitive framing vs cloud AI platforms, LLM APIs, and infra vendors. Primary hooks: routing (latency vs cost), SLA/predictability, private deployment for regulated customers. TL;DR and asks below.

ajay: Uploaded a first pass here: https://docs.google.com/xxx — highlights include proposed field scripts and a single benchmark slide. Asking for concrete claims + evidence. :eyes:

dana: Three soundbites we can iterate on: 1) predictable unit economics at scale, 2) consistent latency SLAs across hosting modes, 3) private deployment without rewriting infra. Short and punchy. :sparkles:

evan: Agree. For field scripts add an if/then line for routing: `if p95 latency > 300ms then route to Dedicated + KV cache`; simple, prescriptive. Also propose a 2-sentence elevator rebuttal vs cloud: they sell access; we sell predictable inference.

tess: Legal note — don't phrase anything as "certified" unless we confirm. For compliance claims use "supports SOC2 readiness" until legal signs off. I'll check exact wording today.

launch-bot: Created ticket ML-6421 for the playbook tasks and webinar checklist. Assigned to @dana, @evan, @ajay.

ajay: For the benchmark narrative: put emphasis on 95th-percentile latency and cost-per-million tokens for typical RLHF/chat workloads. Suggested chart: p50/p95 latency vs cost per 1M tokens across three configs (Hosted, Dedicated, Private). We'll use absolute numbers + % improvements.

dana: I'll draft 3 short rebuttals vs each competitor class — cloud (latency variability, egress/cost surprises), LLM APIs (no routing or private option), infra vendors (ops burden + missing turnkey SLAs). Each rebuttal will include 1 piece of evidence and 1 playbook line for reps.

evan: SDR routing proposal: lead score rules — >50k tokens/month => AE outreach + Dedicated trial; regulated verticals (healthcare/finance/government) => immediate Private-engagement path. Include templated email: "We recommend a Dedicated pilot to validate latency and cost at your scale."

tess: Also verify any benchmarking language that references other vendors' SLAs — cannot assert specifics about competitors unless sourced. I'll flag any risky lines.

maria: Perfect. Asks: Dana + Evan please drop first drafts by EOD. Ajay update the slide with new p95 axis and mock numbers. Tess confirm compliance-safe phrasing by tomorrow AM. I'll stitch into the one-pager and craft two short webinar opener lines. :thumbsup:

ajay: Got it — will update slides and add a short callout box "routing playbook".

dana: Drafts incoming. I'll include suggested soundbites for SDRs and a 30s rebuttal script for AEs.

evan: Will add routing checks and the sample `if/then` snippets to the playbook.

tess: I'll push comments to the doc with approved phrasing and any redlines.

maria: Thanks team — if no major blockers I'll publish the playbook to Confluence after legal thumbs up. We want a single-page PDF for field and a one-slide benchmark visual for the webinar.

launch-bot: Reminder scheduled: webinar dry-run Thu 09:00. Agenda: slides, playbook walk, Q&A.

maria: Great. If anyone has an objection to the framing (predictability + routing + private path) say now, otherwise we'll proceed.

evan: No objection — that framing maps well to buyer pain.

dana: 👍

tess: 👍

ajay: 👍
